title: InvestigationResult
description: Unified output contract for all investigator agents (orchestrator + leaf agents). Every agent that verifies a claim emits exactly this shape. schema_version is a hard-cutover field — consumers must reject unknown versions.

schema_version.description: Always '1'. Hard-cutover versioning: a schema_version bump signals a breaking change.

verdict.description: Outcome of the investigation. VERIFIED_TRUE/FALSE require non-empty evidence[]. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE signals that the claim cannot be confirmed or denied with available sources and propagates to the aggregate. CONTESTED signals genuine expert disagreement with no single authoritative answer.

source.description: Evidence source type. Determines the expected ref format: web=URL, code=GitHub blob URL with #L anchor, linear=ticket URL, github=issue/PR URL, notion=page URL or block id.

ref.description: Stable locator for the source. Format depends on source type (see investigation-result-contract.md).

quote.description: Verbatim or near-verbatim excerpt from the source that supports or contradicts the claim.

evidence.description: Citations that substantiate the verdict. Non-empty for VERIFIED_TRUE and VERIFIED_FALSE; may be empty for INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and CONTESTED.

summary.description: Optional human-readable explanation of the verdict, written by the emitting agent. Required by the orchestrator, optional for leaf agents.

sub_claim.description: Optional. For leaf agents: the exact sub-claim this result addresses, as decomposed by the orchestrator.

adjacent_facts.description: Optional. Orchestrator-only. Bounded expansion: adjacent material facts the asker likely needs, each investigated and cited. Facts with no supporting evidence are excluded. Capped at implementation judgment (typically 2–4).

claim.description: The adjacent fact that was investigated.

evidence.description: Citations for the adjacent fact. Non-empty for VERIFIED_TRUE and VERIFIED_FALSE.

summary.description: Optional. Human-readable explanation of the adjacent-fact verdict.

examples.sub_claim: The function throws on null input.

evidence.quote: if (value === null) throw new Error('null not allowed');

examples.summary: The source confirms null inputs raise an error at line 42.

examples.sub_claim: The PR was merged before the incident.

evidence.quote: Merged on 2026-08-10T14:32Z — two hours after the incident started.

examples.summary: The PR merge timestamp post-dates the incident start, so the claim is false.
No sources returned relevant information for this sub-claim. The aggregate result must reflect this uncertainty.

evidence.quote: Alice: 'The bug was introduced in v2.' Bob: 'Reproduces on v1 as well.'

examples.summary: Engineers disagree on when the bug was introduced; no single authoritative answer is available.
